title: Integral restriction comparison for the cyclic diagonal class
statement: Given IsDiagonalLimit, Family, Reference and a supplied cyclic frame p, the exact-functor Ext image of p.reduce(family.zl.delta) after restriction to discrete integral coefficients equals the restricted cartierResidueReducedPro class at exponent n+1. This asserts neither existence of a frame, nor equality before restriction, nor identification with geoCartierCanonicalClass.

proof.text: Unpack IsDiagonalLimit into its ordinary and derived witnesses, finite normalization, and full normalized-limit tail. Apply the last clause of ArrowCompatibility to delta and its supplied whole-limit equation at n. Obtain the finite endpoint isomorphisms, normalized quotient-unit squares and finite arrow equation.

Use hs0,hs and ht0,ht to identify those source and target projections with the full supported unit and actual root projection. The completed realization unit normalization and normalized condensed cyclic quotient identify the coefficient map with continuous PadicInt.toZModPow. Scalar adjunction uniqueness identifies these units with p.supported and p.line, including the finite line endpoint.

Use c.hom=a.inv f b.hom, exact-single and shift naturality, and finite endpoint isomorphisms s,t. Ext.homEquiv gives equality after integral restriction. Substitute Reference.delta. Apply the n-th finite-cycle equation from IsDiagonalLimit to identify this finite evaluation with the image of cartierResidueReducedPro. The frame construction, cancellation of restriction and canonical boundary comparison are separate, proved parts of the main theorem.

theorem diagonalCyclicEvaluation_transport
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (reference : Reference l Y δ family)
    (n : ℕ)
    (p : CyclicCartierFrame l Y n)
    (hδ : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ) :
    (p.reduce l Y n family.zl.delta).mapExactFunctor
        (diagonalFiniteToPadic l n (diagonalSurface Y)) =
      (cartierResidueReducedPro l (Fact.out : l.Prime) (n + 1)
        (diagonalImmersion Y) (diagonalImmersion_cartier Y)
        (diagonalSurface_power_unit l Y hY n)).mapExactFunctor
          (diagonalFiniteToPadic l n (diagonalSurface Y))
